title: Muc Than Ky Episode 1: The Eye That Sees Death
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, cultivation/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who are drawn to dark supernatural mysteries, sealed powers, and the seer/divine eye trope in Vietnamese and global fantasy content
tone: Ominous, chilling, darkly beautiful, atmospheric, slowly building dread then erupting into supernatural awe

concept.hook: Every grave tells a story. But when his right eye opened — he wished he had never learned to read them.
concept.story_arc: The grave-keeper's daily silence → The forbidden burial ground → A sealed eye cracks → Visions of death flood in → The true power awakens
concept.emotion: Cold dread → Forbidden curiosity → Pain and terror → Sensory overwhelm → Ominous wonder

shots.prompt: Extreme wide shot — a vast ancient Chinese burial ground stretches across a moonless night. Hundreds of stone grave markers and moss-covered tombs spread across a foggy hillside under a heavy black sky. No sound. No light. A single figure in tattered dark grey robes kneels at a grave in the foreground, hands stained with grave dirt, a wooden tool beside him. He is thin, pale, hollow cheeks, exhausted. He works alone in the darkness as he has every night for years — maintaining the forgotten dead. Camera: extreme wide establishing shot, very slow dollies in toward him as he works. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Dolly in — extreme wide to medium, 6s
shots.narration: He was the grave-keeper. The one who tended the tombs no one remembered. For three years he had buried the dead in silence — alone with the forgotten.
shots.sfx: Wind through dead grass, stone scraping against earth, distant owl hoot, grave dirt crumbling, cold night air breathing

shots.prompt: Medium shot — he pauses. His hand freezes over the grave he is tending. Something is wrong. The soil pattern, the positioning of the stone marker — it is different from all the others. Ancient. Forbidden. A burial that should not exist. He looks around. All the other graves face east — except this one, which faces west, directly into the abyss of the dark hillside. His right hand moves involuntarily to his right eye — where a faint old scar runs across his eyelid, barely visible in moonlight. Camera: medium shot, slow zoom in on the forbidden grave, then cut to close-up of his hand on his scarred eye. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Zoom in — on forbidden grave + close-up scarred eye, 6s
shots.narration: But tonight he had wandered too far into the old ground. And found the grave no living person was meant to see — the burial of the Seer King, whose eye could see the moment of death itself.
shots.sfx: Wind suddenly stopping, heartbeat loud and quick, fingernails scraping on stone scar, breath held in fear

shots.prompt: Close-up — he touches the old scar on his right eyelid. A searing pulse of pain shoots through it. He gasps, stumbles back. Blood seeps from the scar — black-red, unnatural. He clutches his face. Through his fingers, his right eye — now half-open — begins to glow with a deep violet luminescence. Visions flood in uncontrollably: the spirit of whoever lies in this grave — a robed ancient figure — sitting upright in its tomb, turning its hollow gaze directly at him. Camera: close-up on his face, eye glowing violet with blood, then a stylized vision overlay of the Seer King's spirit sitting upright in its tomb, glowing eyes meeting his. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up face + spirit vision overlay, glowing eye, 6s
shots.narration: The scar on his eye — the one he had carried since birth — tore open. And as blood poured down his face, the Seer King's eye inside him opened for the first time in three thousand years.
shots.sfx: Ancient tomb stone grinding open, spiritual presence hum, blood dripping on stone, gasp of terror, supernatural wind burst

shots.prompt: Medium shot — he falls backward onto the cold ground, hands still clutching his face. The violet glow from his right eye intensifies. Through his eye, the world has become a nightmare — ghostly figures pour from every grave on the hillside, thousands of translucent souls drifting silently, each one looking at him. All the deaths. All the forgotten. He screams but no sound comes out. Ancient glyphs in violet light begin appearing in the air around him, orbiting his body, the script of the Seer King. Camera: wide shot of him on the ground bathed in violet glyph-light with ghostly figures rising from graves, then rapid cuts of haunting death visions through his eye view. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide + rapid death vision cuts through glowing eye, 6s
shots.narration: Visions flooded through him — every death since the first burial on this hill. Thousands of souls. Thousands of final moments. And all of them — were looking at him.
shots.sfx: Supernatural wind howling, thousands of ghostly whispers layered, glyph resonance chime intensifying, heartbeat pounding with terror, spectral voices

shots.prompt: Close-up — he lies still, spent. The violet glow from his right eye dims to a faint steady pulse — like a heartbeat. His breathing slows. The ghostly figures fade back into their graves. He opens his good left eye — normal, human, terrified. Then he slowly opens his Seer eye — the right one — now steady, glowing faintly violet, ancient, knowing. He stares directly at the camera. A slow, cold smile crosses his face. Behind him, the forbidden grave glows faintly violet. Camera: extreme close-up on his two different eyes — one human, one supernatural violet seer eye — then slow push in to his cold knowing smile. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — dual eyes close-up to cold knowing smile, 6s
shots.narration: They called it a curse. A scar. A disfigurement. But tonight he finally understood — it was never broken. It was locked. And the key — had been waiting in the grave all along.
shots.sfx: Heartbeat slowing to steady rhythm, breath calming, faint violet glyph chime fading to silence, wind settling, ominous resolve settling in

audio.narration: He was the grave-keeper. The one who tended the tombs no one remembered. For three years he had buried the dead in silence — alone with the forgotten. But tonight he had wandered too far into the old ground. And found the grave no living person was meant to see — the burial of the Seer King, whose eye could see the moment of death itself. The scar on his eye — the one he had carried since birth — tore open. And as blood poured down his face, the Seer King's eye inside him opened for the first time in three thousand years. Visions flooded through him — every death since the first burial on this hill. Thousands of souls. Thousands of final moments. And all of them — were looking at him. They called it a curse. A scar. A disfigurement. But tonight he finally understood — it was never broken. It was locked. And the key — had been waiting in the grave all along.
